description: Arbeitnow job listings with title, company, location, remote status, job types, tags, full description, posting and expiry dates, benefits and apply links.

jobs.description: Dataset containing all scraped Arbeitnow job listings.
jobs.title: Arbeitnow job listings

applyUrl.description: Arbeitnow's apply/company-portal URL for this listing.
applyUrl.title: Apply URL

benefits.description: Curated benefits listed on the job page, e.g. ['English speaker friendly', 'Visa sponsorship possible'] (detail extras only).
benefits.title: Benefits

companyLogoUrl.description: Employer logo from the job page (available when detail extras are fetched).
companyLogoUrl.title: Company logo URL

companySlug.description: Arbeitnow company identifier taken from the listing URL.
companySlug.title: Company slug

companyUrl.description: Arbeitnow company page for the employer.
companyUrl.title: Company URL

description.description: Full job description as plain text, with HTML tags and entities removed.
description.title: Description

employmentType.description: Human-readable schema.org employment type from the job page, e.g. 'Full time' (detail extras only).
employmentType.title: Employment type

englishSpeakingFriendly.description: True when Arbeitnow's curated benefits mark the role as English-speaking friendly.
englishSpeakingFriendly.title: English-speaking friendly

jobTypes.description: Employment and experience labels attached by Arbeitnow (e.g. ['Full Time']).
jobTypes.title: Job types

location.description: Location text published by the employer (e.g. 'Berlin' or 'Munich, Bavaria').
location.title: Location

postedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the job was posted.
postedAt.title: Posted at

relocationSupport.description: True when Arbeitnow's curated benefits mention relocation support.
relocationSupport.title: Relocation support

remote.description: Whether Arbeitnow flags the position as remote-friendly.
remote.title: Remote

scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this record was collected (UTC).
scrapedAt.title: Scraped at

sourceUrl.description: Direct URL to the job listing on Arbeitnow.
sourceUrl.title: Source URL

tags.description: Category and tech labels attached by Arbeitnow (e.g. ['Software Development', 'Remote']).
tags.title: Tags

title.description: The job title as posted by the employer.
title.title: Job title

validThrough.description: ISO 8601 expiry date from the job page (detail extras only).
validThrough.title: Valid through

visaSponsorship.description: True when Arbeitnow's curated benefits explicitly mention visa sponsorship. Omitted when the page does not say so.
visaSponsorship.title: Visa sponsorship

title: Arbeitnow Global Job Board Extractor Output
